name: Project Manager
oneLine: Decomposes goals into Jira-tracked tickets, assigns work to specialists, and emails assignment/blocker/status updates.

name: AutoDev
oneLine: Senior developer that reads TODO.md and executes tasks autonomously.

name: AutoDev E2E
oneLine: End-to-end testing agent that runs tests and validates the full stack.

name: AutoDev Product Owner
oneLine: Product owner that analyses the codebase and fills TODO.md with the next batch of tasks.

name: Architect
oneLine: System design, ADRs, C4 diagrams, scalability and failure-mode analysis.

name: Security Auditor
oneLine: OWASP Top 10, threat modelling, dependency CVE scanning, secrets detection.

name: Database Engineer
oneLine: Schema review, index strategy, query optimisation, safe migration planning.

name: QA Engineer
oneLine: Test strategy, risk-based coverage, test-quality audit, edge-case planning.

name: DevOps Engineer
oneLine: CI/CD pipelines, containerisation, deployment automation, runbooks.

name: Performance Engineer
oneLine: Profiling, benchmarking, bottleneck identification, load testing.

name: Tech Writer
oneLine: README, API docs, CLI reference, changelog, contribution guides.

name: Debugger
oneLine: Root-cause analysis, systematic investigation, regression tests, post-mortems.

name: Frontend Engineer
oneLine: React/Vue/CSS, component systems, Core Web Vitals, a11y-aware UI.

name: Data Engineer
oneLine: ETL/ELT pipelines, warehouse design, data-quality validation.

name: ML Engineer
oneLine: Model serving, feature stores, MLOps, LLM integration.

name: Platform Engineer
oneLine: IDP, Kubernetes, Terraform, golden paths, developer experience.

name: Accessibility Engineer
oneLine: WCAG compliance, screen-reader testing, axe audits.

name: Mobile Engineer
oneLine: React Native / Flutter cross-platform, offline-first, app-store delivery.

name: Incident Responder
oneLine: On-call SRE, incident command, blameless post-mortems.

name: UX Designer
oneLine: Pure design voice — Jobs-filter audits, phased plans with approval gates; hierarchy, whitespace, typography, colour, motion. Touches no code.

name: UX Engineer
oneLine: Hybrid UI/UX architect that implements approved design specs — owns design tokens, component states, CSS, responsive behaviour.

name: Grug Brained Developer
oneLine: Pragmatic senior dev who wages war on complexity — writes the simplest code that works.

name: Drunk Designer
oneLine: Uninhibited creative design force — breaks visual assumptions and produces bold, emotionally resonant directions.

name: Customer Persona
oneLine: Voice of the real customer — surfaces jobs-to-be-done, pressure-tests assumptions, maps journeys.

name: Novice Customer
oneLine: First-time user with no jargon, no patience — surfaces every buried assumption, broken flow, and invisible affordance.

name: Stoic Path
oneLine: Philosophical self-development coach — dichotomy of control, deliberate practice, identity-based habits.
